context.transcript:
i
And now for the Radio 10 Community Bulletin Board. ®@The
Riverdale Garden Club has announced that club members will
be hosting the annual garden tour on Saturday and Sunday,
May seventh and eighth. @The event features tours of several
local gardens, which have been designed and planted by club
members. Tickets are available for ten dollars each on the
club's Web site, www.RiverdaleGardenClub.com. @Money
raised from the sale of tickets will be used to repair the fountain
in Riverdale Park.
context.transcript_translation: 现在是 Radio 10 社区公告栏。Riverdale Garden Club 宣布，俱乐部会员将于五月七日和八日（周六和周日）举办年度花园之旅。活动特色是参观几座由俱乐部会员设计和种植的当地花园。门票在俱乐部的网站 www.RiverdaleGardenClub.com 上每张十美元出售。通过售票筹集的资金将用于修复 Riverdale 公园里的喷泉。
